location: Riverglades, on a hill above Sunnyglade
entrance: A cave just west of the large gates of the fortress, at /way 37.5 37.5 in the Riverglades, on the hill above Sunnyglade on the north side of the zone.

94983.objective: Collect 8 Twilight Bangles from the Twilight's Hammer in the stronghold.
94983.note: Part of the Alliance chain that starts at Farholde Keep. Hand-in leads to Curios of Curiosity for Melanie Sable.

94984.objective: Kill Nar'gurk and recover the Tome of Twilight.
94984.note: Opens after the Alliance chain at Farholde Keep: Curious Trinkets, Scraps of Knowledge and Saving Sunnyglade.

94982.objective: Kill Overlord Mugg and bring his eye back to Commander Brant.
94982.note: Opens after the Alliance chain at Farholde Keep. Choose one of three ogre weapons.

94980.objective: Find someone in Farholde Keep who knows about the mould.
94980.note: Tunk drops the Krol'dok Moulding about half the time. Key Ingredients then asks 12 Iron Bars and 4 Thick Leather for a key to a shortcut.

94975.objective: Collect 15 Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer in the stronghold.
94975.note: Da'grosh waits in the hills west of Rog'mar, after the Horde chain that ends with The Wayward Warrior.

94972.objective: Recover the Tome of Twilight from the stronghold.
94972.note: Opens after the Horde chain from Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.

94968.objective: Kill Overlord Mugg and bring his eye back to Krom'rosh.
94968.note: Opens after the Horde chain from Krom'rosh at Rog'mar. Choose one of three ogre weapons.

94973.objective: Find someone in Rog'mar who knows about the mould.
94973.note: Tunk drops the Krol'dok Moulding about half the time. Key Ingredients then asks 12 Iron Bars and 4 Thick Leather for a key to a shortcut.

96771.objective: Travel to the stronghold and kill Zalfan Moonshadow.
96771.note: From Dalaran in the Alterac Mountains, for both factions.
